claims.text: Candidate two-way coherent RF combining and power division over 24-32 GHz; RF acceptance fails and complete assembly is unvalidated
Balanced branches in the symmetric ideal DUT simulation
Specified 0.51 mm RO4350B core and three 2.92 mm edge-launch footprints
Complete-assembly validation requires YAPNR-owned SSoT and openEMS/PALACE adapters; currently blocked

subject.conditions: Design scope only. 24-32 GHz, 50 ohm ports, 0.51 mm RO4350B core, three 2.92 mm launches. Existing EM records cover only the ideal-resistor DUT at design-window boundaries. Full populated assembly simulation is blocked and no physical specimen or power qualification exists. This local translation has no independent reporter authentication.
